title: 第29章 穿旗袍的美艳丰满女老板
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
胖女人一听眉头皱的更深了，脸上抹的粉都被挤掉了，一脸嫌弃的扫视着李大壮：“原来是个想骗钱的乡巴佬！赶紧走！我们这儿不收自己养的，却非得假冒成野生的老鳖！”

    “你都没看，咋知道我的老鳖是假冒的？你可以不收，但不能侮辱人！”李大壮神情冰冷！

    “还用看老鳖吗？光看你这一身乡巴佬的装扮就知道了！就你这样的穷屌丝，最会骗财骗色了，赶紧走远点，老娘才不会上你的当！”

    胖女人上手去推李大壮，李大壮轻轻一个侧身，胖女人扑了个空，差点摔个狗吃屎！

    李大壮就笑了：“骗财，那是不可能的，骗色倒是有可能，但除非我瞎了眼，不然这辈子都不可能骗你这种肥猪的色，你就把心放肚子里吧！”

    “你！你个死瘪三！臭屌丝！敢骂我是肥猪，老娘挠死你！”

    胖女人像个愤怒的大象似的，张牙舞爪的朝着李大壮扑来！

    李大壮这回特意等胖女人扑倒跟前的时候才忽然侧身，胖女人来不及收回力道，终于摔了个狗吃屎！

    李大壮舒坦的吹了个口哨！

    胖女人又疼又气，简直要气疯了，偏偏吨位太重，趴在地上就像翻了个的老鳖一样，半天没爬起来！

    引得几个买药的客人纷纷侧目，捂着嘴偷笑。

    “闹腾什么呢？”

    一个不耐烦的声音从二楼传来，接着走下来一个身穿开叉旗袍，脚踩细高跟的性感女人。

    女人大概三十五岁左右，身段丰腴饱满，皮肤白皙嫩滑，保养得当的脸上，没有一丝纹路，行动间风姿摇曳，妥妥的成熟尤物，正是这家药房的老板娘，柳燕！

    “姨妈！这小瘪三欺负我！呜呜呜！”

    胖女人一看见柳燕，立刻指着李大壮哇哇大哭起来。
content_en:
Li Dazhuang's flames instantly shot up into the sky. Even if he suppressed it again and again, it could not be suppressed. He could only quickly put the bucket in front of him and didn't dare to look at it anymore!

    Liu Yan felt a little disappointed when she saw that he no longer looked at her, but suddenly she saw the old turtle in Li Dazhuang's bucket, and her beautiful eyes suddenly lit up!

    "This old turtle is so big, and it looks like a wild one. Is it yours!?"

    "Can I carry it if it's not mine?" Li Dazhuang said angrily: "I came to your store just to sell old turtles, but since your good niece calls me a liar, I won't waste my time with you!"

    "If you don't know the goods, of course there are people who know the goods!"

    Li Dazhuang turned around and was about to leave. After taking a look at the beauty's delicate body, the flames couldn't stop, so he couldn't stay any longer!

    Hearing this, Liu Yan glared at Li Xiaonan and hurriedly chased after Li Dazhuang: "Handsome man, don't leave yet! My niece doesn't know the goods. I know the goods. Show me the old turtle. If it's really wild, I will definitely buy it at a high price!"

    "Forget it, I don't want to sell it to you anymore!" Li Dazhuang said coldly, but in fact he had no choice. If he didn't leave, the rising flame would be discovered, and he must not be regarded as a hooligan!

    But the faster Li Dazhuang walked, the closer Liu Yan chased after him. She hadn't seen such a big old turtle for a long time, and she really wanted it!

    Li Xiaonan, who finally got up from the ground, also rushed forward to stop Li Dazhuang: "You idiot, you haven't apologized to me yet, stop right there!"

    But it was really hard for her to run with her fat body, so Zaizai stupefiedly pounced on Liu Yan. Liu Yan couldn't resist the fat body Li Xiaonan's pounce, and she was knocked straight away!

    "Ah!!"

    "Aunt!!"

    Liu Yan's scream and Li Xiaonan's exclamation sounded at the same time!

    Li Dazhuang turned around reflexively and saw Liu Yan falling towards the ground with her face turned pale!

    Li Dazhuang didn't have time to think about it, and immediately ran a few steps and caught Liu Yan's plump and tender body with one hand. That big hand accidentally placed it where it shouldn't be. The palm of his hand was soft and round, and the wonderful feel made him unable to help...

    "Oh~~~"

    Liu Yan immediately hummed, it was so comfortable~

    She had been single for many years and hadn't enjoyed a man's caress for a long time. Li Dazhuang's hot hands allowed her to experience the wonderful feeling again. It also calmed her fear of almost falling, causing her to involuntarily press closer to Li Dazhuang...

    "Auntie! What are you doing? Let this little brat apologize to me!" Li Xiaonan shouted in a helpless voice.

    Liu Yan suddenly came back to her senses. Even though she was as mature as she was, she couldn't help but blush when she thought about what she had just been thinking, especially because Li Dazhuang's hand was still there with her!

    "Handsome boy, can you take your hand away?" Liu Yan looked at Li Dazhuang with charming eyes like silk.
